description: After ensureVad/ensureEmbedding/ensureAsr load (ModelWarmup and live-run loads), run ~1 s of silence through each model (encoder + a few decoder steps for ASR) so JIT tier-up, shader compilation and allocator growth happen at launch instead of on the first utterance. Only report the model ready after warm-up. Scheduler already ignores the first 2 STT runs; revisit once warm-up exists.
title: Warm-up inference after model load
